newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Argyle Q2 shr loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Argyle Q2 shr loss narrows.

text.p: NOTES: (a) Includes results from WZZM, WAPT, WNAC, KITV and WGRZ for the entire period and the Arkansas Stations for June, only.

(b) Includes results from WAPT, KITV and the Arkansas Stations for the entire period, WZZM and WGRZ for January, WLWT and KOCO for February-June and the Company's share of the Clear Channel Venture (WNAC/WPRI) for the entire period. The Company's share of the Clear Channel Venture broadcast cash flows is included in total revenues.

On March 26, Argyle announced that it had entered into a pact with the Hearst Corp to combine the television broadcasting division of Hearst with and into Argyle, to be renamed "Hearst-Argyle Television Inc." Argyle has set August 28 for a meeting of its stockholders to consider the deal.
If approved, the deal would close August 29.

Using Argyle's pro forma results and assuming that the Hearst deal had occurred at the beginning of the respective periods, the combined company would have had total pro forma revenues for the three and six months ending June 30, 1997 of $104. million and $185.3 million, respectively, compared to $101.0 million and $181.6 million for the 1996 periods.

Pro forma broadcast cash flow for the three and six months ending June 30, 1997 of $52.3 million and $81.8 million, respectively, compared to $46.9 million and $74.5 million for the 1996 periods, and pro forma EBITDA for the three and six months ending June 30, 1997 of $49.6 million and $76.3 million, compared to $44.1 million and $69.0 million for the three and six-month periods in 1996.
Pro forma revenues and broadcast cash flow do not give effect to any synergy or economies of scale that may occur as a result of the merger.
Full co name is Argyle Television Inc.
